system.description:
Sevens Traits

Type: Humanoid. While they may take on a variety of body-plans, their sapience and material nature make them Humanoids for the purpose of spells and effects.

Age: Loqren-77 grow at an accelerated rate, often reaching physical maturity days or even hours after they’ve been hatched and they’ve been given telepathic education from the hive. However, they tend to live between 5 and 50 years, depending on their size and function.

Size: Adventuring type Loqren-77 are Small or Medium sized.

Speed: Your base speed is 30ft.

Touch Telepathy: So long as you are in physical contact with another entity, you can telepathically communicate with it, even if you do not share a language.

Photosynthetic: While exposed to the light of a natural or artificial star containing UV wavelengths, you can endure a number of days without Supply equal to your Constitution modifier before gaining fatigue.

Carapace: Due to your exoskeletal structure your armor class when unarmored is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit.

Sevens Gifts

Loqren-77 are an incredibly varied species which modify their members to fulfill a wide variety of roles. In addition to the traits found in your loqren-77 heritage, select one of the following sevens gifts:

Amplifier

Sense Motive: Your telepathic awareness allows you to sense motivations in the people around you, granting you expertise on Insight and Persuasion checks.

Telepathy: Your touch telepathy gains a range of 120ft and no longer requires physical contact.

Conduit

Cutting Torch: By channeling intense light or other energies to a fine point through your fingertips, you are able to act as a cutting torch. When targeting an inanimate and stationary object within 5ft of you with this ability, you deal 4d8 radiant damage to the object as an action. You may use this action a number of times per long rest equal to your proficiency bonus.

Laser Channel: You may make a ranged unarmed weapon attack with your conduits. This natural weapon has a range of 60/90ft and deals 1d4 + your Dexterity modifier in radiant damage. You may use this attack once per round unless you are in an area of bright light, in which case you may make multiple attacks.

Transporter

Bulk Goods: Grown specifically to carry large and heavy objects, you can carry an additional 2 bulky items balanced on, or strapped to, your rear torso.

Heavyweight: Your carrying capacity is tripled.

Motility: Due to your additional limbs and their ratcheting functions your speed increases by 10ft and your jumping distance doubles, so long as you do not exceed half of your carrying capacity and are not holding more than three bulky items.

Sevens Paragon Gifts

Amplifier Paragon

Your amplifier helps to insulate your nervous system against psionic attacks, granting you resistance to psychic damage. If you have resistance from another source, you instead gain immunity to psychic damage.

Conduit Paragon

The damage you deal with your cutting torch increases to 6d8 and your laser channel to 1d8 + Dexterity modifier.

Transporter Paragon

You gain a climb speed of 40ft. This climb speed allows you to keep both hands free and even climb upside down on a horizontal surface.
